No front door

Followers stay followers

Someone can follow you for a year, learn a lot, and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

The DM inbox does the selling

"FREEDOM" brings in curious people and serious people in the same queue. You or your team sort them by hand, one conversation at a time, before anyone has seen how you teach.

Content treadmill

2,110 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next episode. When you take a week off, the applications take a week off too.

The people who love your content but aren't ready to apply today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that sells Crypto Made Easy and fills Masterheart

You already have the audience and the membership levels. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches how you think about money, offers your Level 2 membership on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for Masterheart. Meta ads then put that class in front of new people every day.

Fixes the missing front door

One free class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every sign-up is an email you own, and every viewer sees how you teach before you ask for anything.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites people who want your direct guidance to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you where they are with money today.

Puts your memberships to work

Crypto Made Easy is offered at the exact moment people are most motivated, on the thank-you page, instead of waiting on a Whop page. It helps pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for Masterheart yet

They join the free class, start Crypto Made Easy from the thank-you page, and keep learning from your emails and podcast. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for your direct guidance

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for Masterheart.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

People who want to build private wealth on solid foundations, understand what they keep after tax, and learn about digital assets calmly, without the hype.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay for 48 hours, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Is it really free?

Yes. Your price today is free: the 60-minute live masterclass, the Private Wealth starter worksheet, live Q&A with Oto and the 48-hour replay.

What happens after the class?

At the end, Oto explains how Crypto Made Easy and Masterheart work, so you can choose the support that fits where you are. There's no obligation to do either.

Is this financial advice?

No. It's educational content only, not financial, tax, legal or investment advice. Digital assets are volatile and you can lose money. No results are promised.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The tip that costs you"

Hook
"The most expensive money advice is the free tip you got last week. Here's why." (to camera, natural light, the same look as your profile)
Body
"Tips skip the boring part: the foundations. How much you keep after tax, what you can afford to learn with, what you actually understand. I've spent 16 years in taxes and 14 in crypto, and the people who do well over time are the ones who build the base first." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach the foundations in a free 60-minute class called The Private Wealth Blueprint. Tap Sign up to save your seat. Education only, not financial advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before any money decision"

Hook
"Before any money decision, I ask myself three questions." (Oto holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: do I actually understand this, or did someone just sound sure? Two: what does it mean for what I keep after tax? Three: could I sleep tonight if it went the other way? If any answer is no, I wait." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go through the full framework in my free masterclass. Link below. Educational content, not financial advice."

"If you're new here, don't jump into anything yet. Come to my free class first. You'll learn how I think about money, taxes and digital assets, and you'll know which next step fits where you are."
